claims.text: After the disastrous War of Palisor, Tareg led his hosts north-westwards upon hearing the rumour of the newly arrived Gnomes. His hosts were then joined by many of the lost kindreds.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), The Book of Lost Tales Part One, "X. Gilfanon's Tale: The Travail of the Noldoli and the Coming of Mankind", The Awakening of Men according to the later outline, p. 237

claims.text: Tareg and his host eventually arrived in the northwest of the Great Lands, where they met the exiled Gnomes at the Feast of Reunion, as well as the Men led by Ermon, who were about to prepare for a war with Melko. There, Tareg joined forces with the host of Nólemë (the leader of the Gnomes), along with the sons of Ermon, and, at a place called Gorfalong, fought a great battle with Melko and his forces, many of whom were Men corrupted by Melko.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, Christopher Tolkien (ed.), The Book of Lost Tales Part One, "X. Gilfanon's Tale: The Travail of the Noldoli and the Coming of Mankind", The History of the Exiled Gnomes according to the later outline, pp. 240-1
